# MDM command history

Query Jamf Pro MDM **command history** with RSQL filters. Device **actions** (reboot, lock, erase) live on [computers](/docs/docs/computers) (Pro) or [devices](/docs/docs/devices) (Platform).

## Agent rules

- Do not treat this as the way to **issue** MDM actions — use `computer_*` / Platform device action builtins.
- Do not invent date filters without RSQL range operators (see api-endpoints MDM + RSQL notes).

## Facts

- List / find: `mdm_commands(filter=…)` · `buddy mdm list --filter=…` — Bare term → `status=="term"`, or full RSQL
- Device **actions** (reboot, lock, erase) live on [computers](/docs/docs/computers) or Platform [devices](/docs/docs/devices).

## Builtins

### mdm_commands

List MDM command history

Returns: list of dicts

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "description": "filter",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "filter"
  ],
  "title": "mdm_commands",
  "type": "object"

```

## Examples

    return mdm_commands(filter="Pending")
